items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: But, I mean, we saw each other like, say, like you and I are talking now.

ctx.x: times through the years, like he was at the Roseland Ballroom most of the time. Ovie Alston, I think, was the singer. Orlando Robeson was his singer also.

And then, I met him. Well, we played a lot of dances off and on. I went down to, when he took out J. Roseland (inaudible), I went down and played in his place. But, I mean, we saw each other like, say, like you and I are talking now.
I don't know where he is now, but I know he was up here at the Nebula for years. And, I think his theme right then, 'I'd Do Most Anything For You'. But, he was a sweetheart. We had a lot of fun.
